reason: I already pay for magic tricks, and a phone mind-reading routine in Hebrew that I can try for free first is exactly what I'd show off in my WhatsApp groups. If the free tricks fool my friends, I'd pay the 99 the same night.
objection: 99 ₪ feels steep for an app, and I'm a bit wary of typing my card into some website instead of the App Store, plus I worry the 'incoming call' or 'search' tricks look fake up close.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks felt clunky or obviously staged when I tried them on a friend, I wouldn't pay.
